read-only capture france-mgmt.txt (section INPUT-live). The node runs
iptables v1.8.10 (nf_tables): its rules.v4 says "Generated by iptables-save
v1.8.10 (nf_tables)". The chain holds no public address. It shows the form
the nf_tables backend prints for the WINN3GW-INPUT jump, -d before -i, which
place_winn3gw_input_jump in wins_winn3_gateway_install.sh matches exactly;
wins_winn3_gateway_install_interactions_test.sh runs both jump builders
against it. No iptables-legacy capture exists in this repository, so the
legacy backend's form is not pinned by a fixture.
